tables.TABLE_COMMENT: Audit trail for all inventory changes
Tracks PPM offline batch sync attempts for idempotency

columns.COLUMN_COMMENT: When part was returned to inventory
Positive for add, negative for remove
ID of related record (return_id, wo_task_parts_id, etc)
Reason from dropdown: unused_excess, wrong_part, damaged, other
Total number of actions in batch
Server timestamp when sync was processed
Filesystem relative path to current signature image
SHA-256 hash of file content for integrity

1=Assign to himself
2=Assign to User
3=Assign to Group
JSON data of the imported row
Created work order ID if successful
1=complain, 2=before, 3=during, 4=after, 5=signiture complainer, 6=signiture responder, 7=signiture executor, 8=signiture verified, 9=signiture wr checked, 10=signiture wr verified
